_comment: Grid combat tunables. Per-part numbers live on each part's `grid` block in data/parts/; terrain numbers on each tile's `grid` block in data/terrain/tiles.json. The damage-type wheel is `effectiveness` in data/balance.json.
_objectives: rout: destroy every enemy. defend: caches (immobile) on the board; survive `rounds` rounds or rout; every cache left pays out. salvage: piles on the board; collect `need` of them or rout. A destroyed machine always bursts into a scrap pile.
